entities.name: Q873G4 Histone H2A.Z
observations: The 143-aa query exactly matches reviewed UniProt Q873G4 from Neurospora crassa (100% identity and coverage).
Curated reference annotation: H2A.Z variant histone that replaces H2A in some nucleosomes; associated with chromatin organization and transcription regulation; localized to nucleus and chromosome.
Sequence-derived estimates: 15,287.6 Da; theoretical pI 10.35; predicted charge at pH 7 of +15.76.
Pfam hits: Histone PF00125 (residues 22–103) and Histone_H2A_C PF16211 (residues 105–137).
